source: BARC Crop Zoning Information System (CZIS), WFS layer wsBARC:upazila_landtype, from SRDI soil survey data
processing: Soil unit at grid points every 0.005 degrees inside Rajshahi, Chapainawabganj, Natore and Naogaon (geoBoundaries outlines). Cell values: index into units; -1 outside the four districts; -2 no soil unit (rivers, towns).
